name: update_plan
description: Update the plan (todos.md) or record a finding. target='plan': create, read, complete, revise, or archive the task plan. target='findings': append a fact or discovery to the ## Findings section of todos.md.

target.description: plan: operate on todos.md. findings: append content to the ## Findings section of todos.md.

action.description: (target=plan) create: write new todos.md with ## Findings and ## Archive sections. read: return todos.md content. complete: mark a task [x]. revise: replace a failed task. archive: move a completed phase into the ## Archive section.

plan.description: (target=plan, action=create) Full todos.md content to write (active phases only — ## Findings and ## Archive sections are appended automatically).

task.description: (target=plan, action=complete) Text of the task as it appears after '- [ ]' in todos.md.

phase.description: (target=plan, action=archive) Phase heading to archive (e.g. '## Phase 1: Name').

failed_task.description: (target=plan, action=revise) Text of the failed task as it appears after '- [ ]' in todos.md.

tried.description: (target=plan, action=revise) What was attempted and why it failed — recorded as a '- ✗' line in the plan.

replacement_tasks.description: (target=plan, action=revise) Newline-separated replacement tasks to insert. Include '[decomposed] ' prefix where appropriate.

content.description: (target=findings) The fact or discovery to record.
